metadata.title: Lorlatinib Therapy
metadata.indication: Adult ALK-positive advanced NSCLC after progression on alectinib/ceritinib as first ALK TKI, or crizotinib and at least one other ALK TKI.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-reconciled lorlatinib pathways with explicit source conflicts; independent review pending

organ_function_reconciliation.note: Structured renal/hepatic component rules were reconciled to the current official NCCP regimen source. Independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation remains pending.
organ_function_reconciliation.supersession_note: Historical v0.59.0 audit retained; current hepatic source conflict is explicitly represented in v0.84.24 rules.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.source_retrieval_method: Fresh official migrated v3 PDF downloaded and critical tables visually inspected; indexed legacy v4 could not be downloaded (404).

source_conflicts.available: Fresh migrated v3 has only 00570a; preserve v3 metadata and active indication.
source_conflicts.discrepancy: Search-indexed legacy v4 claims 00570b first-line and CDS 01/10/2022, but fresh download/open/screenshot return 404. Not verified as current source.
source_conflicts.supplement: Current EMA 4.1 independently licenses ALK-inhibitor-naive advanced NSCLC; source verification review gate retained.

source_conflicts.ema: Mild/moderate no adjustment; severe Child-Pugh C starting 50 mg
source_conflicts.resolution: Consultant/pharmacy source reconciliation; no automated hepatic dose.

source_conflicts.ema: Current 4.5 reports no clinically meaningful effect of modafinil on lorlatinib pharmacokinetics
source_conflicts.resolution: Specific interaction review; no automatic class-wide dose change.

metadata.schedule_summary: Lorlatinib is taken once daily continuously, with no planned rest week. Treatment continues while it is helping and side effects remain acceptable; there is no fixed number of treatment cycles.

source_supplements.label: EMA Lorviqua current product information and patient leaflet
source_supplements.basis: Audited product information supplement; NCCP differences remain explicit

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable action; all dose modifications require Consultant review. Reconcile current EMA/NCCP conflicts with oncology pharmacy, verify recovery and current dose, and do not multiply dose reductions.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00570 Version 3. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Reconciled against NCCP v3 and current EMA in v0.84.24; hepatic source conflict and renal-measure distinction require specialist review. Historical v0.59.0 record is superseded.

lorlatinib_crcl_ml_min.label: Creatinine clearance (NCCP renal threshold)
lorlatinib_crcl_ml_min.assessment_guidance: NCCP uses CrCl; current EMA uses absolute eGFR. Do not substitute indexed eGFR in mL/min/1.73 m². Values below 30 trigger source dosing review; exactly 30 does not.

renal_input.reason: NCCP Table 2 uses the threshold CrCl <30 versus ≥30 mL/min, not a continuous dosing formula.

hepatic_impairment.label: Clinician-assessed hepatic impairment
hepatic_impairment.assessment_guidance: NCCP and current EMA dosing disagree for moderate/severe hepatic impairment. Do not classify chronic hepatic impairment from an isolated ALT/AST result.

hereditary_sugar_intolerance.label: Rare hereditary galactose intolerance, total lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption
hereditary_sugar_intolerance.assessment_guidance: Lorviqua contains lactose. This refers to the named rare hereditary disorders, not ordinary dietary lactose intolerance.

eligibility: Indication as listed in the current official NCCP regimen
Performance status, histology, stage and biomarker eligibility appropriate to the selected indication
Organ function appropriate for the selected regimen
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the interactive assessment
monitoring: Baseline: validated ALK result, FBC, renal/liver profile, lipid profile, coagulation, ECG, blood pressure, glucose, amylase and lipase.
Lipids at 2, 4 and 8 weeks then clinically appropriate; BP after 2 weeks and at least monthly.
FBC, renal/liver profile, ECG and amylase/lipase monthly; ECG may be more frequent if indicated; glucose as clinically indicated.
Consider baseline and ongoing LVEF assessment with cardiac risk/conditions; assess new symptoms at any time.
Disease monitoring per supervising Consultant plan; no fixed scan or treatment duration.
dose_modifications: NCCP 00570 v3Tables 1–3 and current EMA 4.2 separately cited. Same-dose severe lipid pathway, CNS/ILD/AV-block/metabolic holds, recurrence and permanent-stop pathways encoded.
Source levels 100→75→50 mg; no automatic multiplication of reductions. Current dose, recovery and clinical review determine restart.
Hepatic source conflict and first-line NCCP source discrepancy require explicit Consultant/pharmacy review.
